The '''East Wing''' of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] was a set of offices and hallways on the eastern side of the Senate Annex Dome. This wing was the location where [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and his team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|captured]] several members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during a meeting to discuss the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]].<ref name="HC" />

In the main area [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Philo/Legends|Philo]] was shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Bane when he attempted to leave. The atrium was destroyed and the wing damaged when [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]] set by Bane and his team detonated. The senators were saved by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="HC" />
